value: SRMA: Department of Homeland Security (CISA); FERC Division of Dam Safety and Inspections (non-federal hydropower licensees); U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (federal dams/levees); Bureau of Reclamation (federal dams); NERC (hydro generators meeting BES criteria)
FERC Security Program for Hydropower Projects (Rev. 3A)
FERC D2SI Security Program, incl. Section 9 cyber/SCADA and Form 3 Cyber Security Inspection Checklist

The only dam-specific federal security program with explicit cyber/SCADA requirements, inspected by FERC D2SI. Hydro generators that are BES assets must also meet NERC CIP; federal (USACE/USBR) dams follow internal federal (FISMA) controls instead.
CEII (dam inundation maps, design data; 18 CFR 388.113); Vulnerability/Security Assessments and Security Plans; PCII; BES Cyber System Information (for BES hydro)

Spillway and gate control PLCs; Hydro unit control/governor systems; SCADA and remote control centers for multiple projects; Dam safety instrumentation and early-warning systems; Levee pump station controls
CIRCIA NPRM has no dams-specific sector criterion; hydro owners are covered via NERC CIP/OE-417 criterion or size standard.
